description: Watches a release drop folder and files each artifact arrival, attested by its SHA-384 digest, as Oracle signals.
name: release_drop

signals.description: An artifact never seen before landed in the drop folder; the detail carries its full SHA-384 digest.
signals.name: artifact_arrived

signals.description: A known artifact name reappeared in the drop folder with a different SHA-384 digest.
signals.name: artifact_changed
